description:
Get what to draw for one map view: clusters, pins, or named pins.

    Send the view as `bbox`, or as `lat` + `lng` + `radius_miles`. The detail
    returned depends on the zoom the view is answered at (the response states it
    in `zoom`):
      - zoom 3-12  -> mode 'clusters': a count per grid cell. Each cluster has
        `count`, `bbox`, `breakdown` and `expansionZoom` (fit the map to `bbox` at
        that zoom and the cluster comes apart).
      - zoom 13-14 -> mode 'pins': one pin per address, position only, no name.
      - zoom 15+   -> mode 'markers': pins with `label` (first initial and last
        name), `housingStatus`, `hasPhoto`, `registryState`.
    A close view holding more than 300 pins is answered as clusters instead.

    Returns: { mode, zoom, bbox, datasetVersion, total, breakdown {street, housed,
    homeless, incarcerated}, clusters[], markers[], areas[], unplaced {count,
    states}, notice }. In radius mode also `center`, `radiusMiles` and
    `withinRadius` (exact), and each marker has `distanceMiles`.
      - A marker with `id: null` and a `groupId` stands for several people at one
        address: call map_group with that `groupId`.
      - `areas` are people placed only at the middle of a ZIP, city or county;
        each has a `groupId` too. Never describe them as being at an exact spot.
      - `unplaced` counts people in the states this view touches who have no
        mappable address. Mention it rather than implying the map shows everyone.
      - To see who one marker is, call map_open_record with its `id`.

    A pin shows a REGISTERED ADDRESS, not a person's current location — say so
    when you describe a result (`notice` carries the sentence).

    Billing: one map request per call ($2 per 1,000), whatever the view holds. Marker and group
    ids work for 24 hours. The Map API must be turned on for the account
    (the API answers 403 `map_not_enabled` otherwise); `sandbox=true` works
    without it.

    Auth: uses the caller's X-API-Key (request header or OFFENDERSEARCH_API_KEY env).

bbox.description: The view as 'west,south,east,north' in degrees, e.g. '-83.5,39.6,-82.4,40.3'. Any size. Send this OR lat/lng with radius_miles, not both.
bbox.title: Bbox

detail.description: full = clusters or pins (default); count = numbers only.
detail.title: Detail

housing.description: Keep only people with one of these housing statuses.
housing.title: Housing

lat.description: Latitude of the centre, instead of bbox (send with lng and radius_miles).
lat.title: Lat

lng.description: Longitude of the centre, instead of bbox (send with lat and radius_miles).
lng.title: Lng

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles around lat/lng, 0.1 to 100.
radius_miles.title: Radius Miles

sandbox.description: If true, answer in test mode: made-up people (labels start with 'Sample') in the real response shape. Needs no plan and is never billed.
sandbox.title: Sandbox

street_only.description: If true, keep only people with an exact street address.
street_only.title: Street Only

zoom.description: Optional map zoom, 0 to 22. Decides the detail: 3-12 clusters, 13-14 pins without names, 15+ pins with names. Omit it and the zoom is worked out from the size of the view.
zoom.title: Zoom

name: map_viewport
